'''Chocolate milk''' is milk flavoured with [[Cookbook:Chocolate|chocolate]].

== Ingredients ==
* [[Cookbook:Milk|Milk]] (as much as you want to make)
* Chocolate syrup or melted [[Cookbook:Chocolate|chocolate]] (to taste)

== Procedure ==
# Pour milk into a glass or jug.
# Add the chocolate
# Stir well with a spoon or straw.
# Enjoy!

== Notes, tips, and variations ==

* You can change the amount of chocolate and milk depending on how much chocolate/milk you like.
